tlaContent:
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES state
Init == state = "idle"
Next == \/ Login \/ Logout \/ Register
Login == state = "idle" /\ state' = "active"
Logout == state = "active" /\ state' = "idle"
Register == state = "idle" /\ state' = "registered"
TypeInvariant == state \in {"idle", "active", "registered"}
featureContent:
Feature: Test
Background:
  Given state idle
  When Login
  Then TypeInvariant
